description:
Read-only operator views over JobControlRepository: a run, the pending
        runs, the entity status board, the failures and the FDP model status
        for a system and extract date. Binds only to Culvert contracts, found
        through AutoConfig, never to a cloud SDK, so the same views work on
        any backend. Control-plane epic #188, Phase 1 (T1.1, issue #190).
